request.spec:
Live due now rounds half to even (1.025 becomes 1.02, 1.035 becomes 1.04). A settled claim keeps
its frozen figure. Every due-total is now the sum of the already-rounded claim figures, not the
rounded total amount times the rate; a person with nothing that counts shows 0.00. A person whose
grade has no rate today still shows n/a even with nothing that counts (n/a wins over 0.00), unless
a settled claim keeps a figure: then the total is the sum of the figures there are. The sheet's
due-total is still everyone's due-total added up.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Live due now rounds half to even (1.025 becomes 1.02, 1.035 becomes 1.04). A settled claim keeps
its frozen figure. Every due-total is now the sum of the already-rounded claim figures, not the
rounded total amount times the rate; a person with nothing that counts shows 0.00. A person whose
grade has no rate today still shows n/a even with nothing that counts (n/a wins over 0.00), unless
a settled claim keeps a figure: then the total is the sum of the figures there are. The sheet's
due-total is still everyone's due-total added up.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The change is in, and all 4 acceptance tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

- **Rounding:** a live claim's due now rounds half to even (1.025 → 1.02, 1.035 → 1.04). This is in `dueCents` in `src/main/frontend/features/rates/rates.ts`. Settling a claim on the server now freezes the figure with the same rounding (`ApplyClaimStatus.java`), so the frozen figure matches what was on screen. Claims that are already settled keep the figure they were stored with.
- **Person due-total:** a new `personDueCents` in `features/claims/claims.ts` adds up the already-rounded figures of the person's claims that count. If they have none, it shows 0.00. If their grade has no rate today, it shows n/a, unless one of their settled claims kept a figure; then it shows the sum of the figures there are. The person row in `claims.slot.tsx` uses this.
- **Sheet due-total:** `rollup.slot.tsx` adds up every person's due-total and skips the ones showing n/a.

One choice to check: each live claim's figure uses the rate in force on the claim's own date, the same figure its row already shows. Today's rate now only decides whether a person's total shows n/a. Before this change, the person total applied today's rate to their summed amount, so if a grade's rate changed between a claim's date and today, the total will now come out differently.

No stored data or audit record formats changed.
